name: What should I prepare before a plumbing contractor starts work on my remodel?
description: Prepare for plumbing work by clearing the area, ensuring access to fixtures, finalizing selections, and disclosing any known plumbing issues.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a plumbing contractor starts work on my remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a plumbing contractor starts work on your remodel, you should prepare by clearing the work area of personal items and ensuring clear access to plumbing fixtures and shut-off valves. It's also helpful to have your fixture selections finalized, as this impacts the rough-in measurements. Disclosing any known issues with your existing plumbing, like recurring clogs or previous repair history, can provide our team with valuable first-party insight, allowing for more accurate planning and smoother execution from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for plumbing work by clearing the area, ensuring access to fixtures, finalizing selections, and disclosing any known plumbing issues.
